test_title: PYST 4: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 2 )

question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If no substitution is required, select ‘No substitution required’.**

The guard __had gave__ a hard push by the crowd.
solution:
The correct answer is: **was given**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Replace **"had gave" **with &l
